title: Capitola the madcap
author: Emma Dorothy Eliza Nevitte Southworth
description: "Capitola the Madcap" by Emma Dorothy Eliza Nevitte Southworth is a serial novel first published in 1859.
longDescription: The story follows Capitola Black, a tomboyish orphan rescued from New York's streets by wealthy Major Warfield, who makes her heiress to his Virginia plantation.

authorInfo.bio: Emma Dorothy Eliza Nevitte Southworth (1819–1899) wrote Capitola the madcap. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
